application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of materials for the external surfaces in pursuant to condition 3 of planning application ref: 215941HH dated 09/08/2022 for: Single storey rear extension (following demolition of existing) proposed internal alterations involving removal of cupboard in the front room (basement level), removal of ground floor partition to the WC and cupboard, replacement of privacy screen to window above the stairs at basement level, installation of doors to opening between the front and rear rooms at ground floor, removal of fireplace surround in the living room at ground floor, at first floor removal of bathroom sanitary-ware, doors and partitions, reinstatement of original arch into bedrooms, relocation of door to front room and removal of partition wall of the lobby entrance to the bedroom, at second floor removal of cupboard, relocation of doorway and installation of new partition. External alterations; restoration of the wooden treillage porch, decorative ironwork to the first floor balconies, replacement of single glazed timber framed windows to rear and front elevation by double glazed mullioned sash windows, re-painting of front door, minor repairs to guttering and fascia, proposed works to the front boundary wall and a new front bin enclosure, installation of steps to garden from existing basement to Listed Building
